verdict.rationale: BILL's developer portal provides API docs, code recipes, and a sandbox for testing without real money (docs-15, docs-23), which supports some hands-on exploration, but there's no evidence of a true interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) with runnable examples — a probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404 on all checked paths. Missing for 10: an interactive API console or Swagger-UI-style reference, confirmed runnable code examples embedded in docs, and independent corroboration that the API reference itself (not just recipes) is executable in-browser.
